parts.name: API Gateway
parts.summary: Primary backend entry point for auth, jobs, applications, candidates, interviews, workspaces, analytics, health, metrics, storage, and queue publishing.

parts.name: CV Parser
parts.summary: Queue-driven worker that consumes CV upload events, parses documents, applies OCR fallback, and publishes parsed or failed outcomes; persistence is still a no-op placeholder.

parts.name: Notification
parts.summary: Planning-only service for email, WebSocket push, and notification history; no runtime implementation exists in the current snapshot.

integration.storage: S3-compatible object storage (MinIO locally, Cloudflare R2 in production)
integration.database: PostgreSQL via Prisma in API Gateway
integration.notes: API Gateway publishes cv.uploaded; CV Parser consumes it and publishes cv.parsed/cv.failed; Notification is documented as a future consumer in legacy/planning docs.
